content.test_md_blob:
# Keep single-page state across repeated sidebar switches

> Prove repeated sidebar changes across primary, analytics, research, and system contexts keep the dashboard in the same single-page shell while the active item and workspace heading update in place.

## Step 1

Open ORBITAL at {{start_url}} in a fresh browser session.

## Step 2

Store the current browser URL as baseline_url, the current workspace heading as heading_1, and the active sidebar item as active_1.

## Step 3

In the left sidebar, activate the Portfolio item in the PRIMARY section; store the resulting workspace heading as heading_2 and the resulting active sidebar item as active_2.

## Step 4

Assert the current browser URL still equals baseline_url, active_2 is Portfolio, and heading_2 differs from heading_1.

## Step 5

In the left sidebar, activate the Performance item in the ANALYTICS section; store the resulting workspace heading as heading_3 and the resulting active sidebar item as active_3.

## Step 6

Assert the current browser URL still equals baseline_url, active_3 is Performance, and heading_3 differs from heading_2.

## Step 7

In the left sidebar, activate the Research Notes item in the RESEARCH section; store the resulting workspace heading as heading_4 and the resulting active sidebar item as active_4.

## Step 8

Assert the current browser URL still equals baseline_url, active_4 is Research Notes, and heading_4 differs from heading_3.

## Step 9

In the left sidebar, activate the Alerts item in the SYSTEM section; store the resulting workspace heading as heading_5 and the resulting active sidebar item as active_5.

## Step 10

Assert the current browser URL still equals baseline_url, active_5 is Alerts, and heading_5 differs from heading_4.

## Step 11 — assert @verifies ac-1, ac-7, ac-8

Confirm 'application routing, separate dashboard pages, navigation to another URL, or a multi-page workflow caused by sidebar navigation' does NOT appear (forbidden-presence) — the stated promise: Activating a sidebar navigation item keeps the application within the same page instead of routing away.
